positioning: Shared governance/persistence/execution kernel with independent application semantics per vertical

capabilities: Host-owned tool execution ledger and continuation
isolated scoped qualification with Judge positive/negative controls

verticals.purpose: learner state, uncertainty and intervention verification
durable preferences/plans, realtime isolation and risk escalation

hardBoundaries: Only infrastructure concerns are unified across verticals; domain state models remain independent.
LLM output is untrusted candidate data.
Realtime facts are not silently persisted as long-term Life state.
Tutor assistance affects the interpretation of mastery evidence.
Research conflict evidence fails closed on material omission.
Generic agent execution graph does not grant authority by itself.
External model output remains candidate data until deterministic/MAG gates pass.
Tool calls are requests only; allowlisted side effects are executed by the Host-owned tool ledger.
Research delivery requires explicit bound-delivery semantic Judge evidence; a separate Judge identity is preferred/optionally required.
Retrieved document text is untrusted data; evidence extraction instructions explicitly reject embedded prompt/tool/role instructions.

Completed tool-call ledger records can survive normal SQLite-backed restart, but R2 does not claim atomic exactly-once behavior across the crash window between an external side effect and ledger persistence.
Observatory is local-owner and unauthenticated; no remote or multi-tenant claim.
Read-only observability does not replace trusted Host authorization for legacy domain commands.
Fixture qualification is not real model qualification; configuration is not health or qualification.
Execution overlap protection is scoped to one Gateway process, not crash-safe distributed exactly-once.
Exports are best-effort credential-redacted and may retain sensitive business data; not signed audit proofs.
Configured model identity is not proof of distinct weights or statistical independence.
Only env-created finite product HTTP and supplied retrieval providers have R4a HTTP bounds; frozen SDK/custom transports remain caller-owned.
The response validator implements only the owned JSON Schema subset and rejects unsupported keywords.
Qualification does not touch the normal business store; a passed scope cannot replace a wider scope or production qualification.

observatory.shared: navigation / read projections / audit / execution display
observatory.independent: domain state models / application operation forms
observatory.browserQualification: offline DOM only; network E2E blocked by managed URL policy

qualification.scope: R4a implementation / configured endpoint samples / no identity attestation
qualification.evidenceMode: fixture-http for included tests; configured-endpoints-unattested for operator CLI
